summary: Completed frontend-only regression on public preview URL for Hero V3 desktop/mobile, motion, CTA, reduced-motion, console health, and navigation reachability.

ui_bugs.issue: Menu links are inconsistent: Timeline and Tracks scroll correctly, but Legacy/Cars/Victories did not reliably scroll in repeated automated runs.

integration_issues.flow: Menu -> section smooth scroll with Lenis
integration_issues.issue: Section navigation appears partially desynchronized with smooth scrolling state; some section targets remain far from viewport after click despite menu closing.

action_items: Fix menu scroll reliability for Legacy/Cars/Victories and retest all five navigation targets in sequence.
Verify Lenis + scrollIntoView interoperability so section targeting is deterministic across repeated interactions.
Keep HeroV3 behavior unchanged where already passing: desktop parallax stability, CTA-to-Legacy, mobile 390 no overflow, and reduced-motion animation disabling.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroV3.css is compressed into a near-single-line stylesheet, which hurts maintainability and targeted debugging.
Global selector `html,body,#root,.app-shell,.hero-v3{position:relative!important}` is broad and may have side effects beyond hero scroll calculations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://ui-revamp-dynamics.preview.emergentagent.com. PASS: Hero V3 core render and assets, STILL/WE RISE text readability, stable pointer tilt/parallax without layout jump, decorative primitives present (token/orbits/track/scan/shine/lights/floor), stats settle at 105/7/104, CTA reaches Legacy, 390px mobile has no horizontal overflow and key hero content remains visible/readable, reduced-motion disables looping hero animations, no console warnings/errors observed. PASS: HeroV2.css is not imported in App.js (only HeroV3.css imported). FAIL/FLAKY: menu navigation links inconsistent for Legacy/Cars/Victories in repeated sequential runs.
rca of the issue: Repro: desktop 1920x1080, open menu and click targets sequentially. Timeline/Tracks reach viewport top, while Legacy/Cars/Victories can remain offset (e.g., top ~1080, ~12642, ~3842). Likely cause is interaction between smooth `scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})` and Lenis-managed scrolling state/timing, causing incomplete or ignored target scroll updates for some transitions. Mitigation: route all nav jumps through a single Lenis scroll API or disable conflicting native smooth scroll for these interactions and add deterministic completion checks.
